GET YOUR BEARINGS

Quick answers about Nobleton

Where is Nobleton?

Nobleton is a community in southwestern King Township, Ontario. Find official municipal resources in our local information guide.

New to the area?

Start with local schools, parks and the library, and our moving checklist to plan your next steps.

Looking for a local business?

Browse the Nobleton directory. Coverage is growing, and businesses serving the area can submit a free listing.

Can I browse current property listings here?

Browse available properties and connect with Ekaterina Ottchenach or start a Nobleton home search.

Where can I get mortgage help?

Contact Anatoly Shibkov about financing, renewals or refinancing. You can also use the mortgage calculator to explore payment estimates.

Is this the municipal website?

Nobleton.ca is an independent community guide. For municipal services, permits and official notices, visit the Township of King.
